tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification applies to all builds, development builds included; there is no exception that turns verification off for development. The project also records a standing rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
